title: Quadratic stabilization of the Foulkes–Howe map
description: OpenAI's theorem (2026) that the canonical Hermite–Hadamard–Howe map Sym^b(Sym^a V) -> Sym^a(Sym^b V) is surjective for b >= a(a-1) and every finite-dimensional complex V. Symmetric powers and averaging, the image of the map, the diagonal criterion for surjectivity, an injectivity lemma for directional derivatives with the Fischer inner product, the induction that proves the vanishing on products, and an equivariant embedding of the kind asked for by Foulkes' conjecture.

units.title: Symmetric powers and the Foulkes–Howe map

prerequisites: linear algebra over the complex numbers: tensor products, quotient spaces, dual spaces, Hermitian inner products and adjoints
polynomials in several variables and their partial derivatives
